scope: Development-only experiment. No production imports, catalog replacement or certified geometry.

model.creator: Grab3D
model.origin: Independent procedural Blender scripts with AI-assisted code, per source manifest. Not exported from FURY and not a hand-authored/manufacturer model.
model.adapter: Preserve local hierarchy. Rotate +PI/2 about Y, center measured XZ and ground measured Y in meters, then apply 1/0.3048 once. Never scale to catalog dimensions.
model.lodPolicy: Single source LOD only. Crank is static. No decimation, animation, distance transition or performance claim.
materialRoles: body base color / tangent-space RGB normal / metallic-roughness
crank base color / tangent-space RGB normal / metallic-roughness
model.preservation: Keep indices, attributes, hierarchy, two double-sided material slots and six embedded JPEG images. Never pass the GLB through render/parts.batch, which drops extra attributes and groups.
model.decision: Reject as production hero replacement: stylized independent procedural source, not proof of authored-quality improvement. Browser quality/performance unmeasured. Keep as a licensed transport/adapter comparison only.

encoder.name: KTX-Software
encoder.policy: ETC1S qlevel 255 clevel 2 color; UASTC quality 2 + Zstd 18 non-color, normals normalized with RGB retained (no normal_mode swizzle); 1 encoder thread; full wrap-filtered mip chain via --wrapping (4.4.0 help incorrectly says --wmode), lower-left stored rows for compressed flipY=false. Conversion starts from checked-in lossy WebP, not original scans.

decoder.policy: No CDN/latest decoder; expose these hash-pinned bytes from a versioned same-origin DEV-only path. One loader/worker pool per pilot owner; detectSupport(renderer) before loading; dispose loader and owned textures on release. Actual supported target format and worker heap unmeasured.
